sloka: स चापमादाय भुजङ्गकल्पं दृढज्यमुग्रं तपनीयचित्रम्।हरीन् समाश्वास्य समुत्पपात रामो निबद्धोत्तमतूणबाणः ।। ६.६७.१२३ ।।
transliteration: sa cāpamādāya bhujaṅgakalpaṁ dṛḍhajyamugraṁ tapanīyacitram।harīn samāśvāsya samutpapāta rāmo nibaddhottamatūṇabāṇaḥ ।। 6.67.123 ।।

translations.english: Pierced by arrows excessively all over his limbs, bathing in blood flowing from the injury was like a mountain with a spring.
